review_controller_observation_shape.name: review_controller_observation_shape
review_controller_observation_shape.value:
(
      ("review_controller_shadow_observations"."event_kind" = 'pull_request' AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."pull_request" IS NOT NULL AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."base_sha" IS NOT NULL
        AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."base_tree_sha" IS NOT NULL AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."manifest_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."file_count" IS NOT NULL)
      OR
      ("review_controller_shadow_observations"."event_kind" = 'merge_group' AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."pull_request" IS NULL AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."base_sha" IS NOT NULL
        AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."base_tree_sha" IS NULL AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."manifest_sha256" IS NULL AND "review_controller_shadow_observations"."file_count" IS NULL)
    )

user_devices_device_type_check.name: user_devices_device_type_check
user_devices_device_type_check.value: device_type IS NULL OR device_type IN ('desktop', 'mobile', 'tablet', 'cli')

budget_incidents_resolution_check.name: budget_incidents_resolution_check
budget_incidents_resolution_check.value: resolution IS NULL OR resolution IN ('limit_raised', 'policy_deactivated', 'override', 'window_rolled')

budget_policies_warn_check.name: budget_policies_warn_check
budget_policies_warn_check.value: warn_percent IS NULL OR (warn_percent > 0 AND warn_percent < 100)

error_events_context_check.name: error_events_context_check
error_events_context_check.value: context IS NULL OR context IN ('server', 'client', 'edge')

workspace_inference_configs_key_pairing_.name: workspace_inference_configs_key_pairing_check
workspace_inference_configs_key_pairing_.value:
(
        (provider IN ('inference-snaps', 'ollama') AND encrypted_api_key IS NULL)
        OR
        (provider IN ('anthropic', 'openai', 'groq', 'huggingface') AND encrypted_api_key IS NOT NULL)
      )

licenses_perpetual_user_tier_unique.name: licenses_perpetual_user_tier_unique
licenses_perpetual_user_tier_unique.where: perpetual = true AND deleted_at IS NULL

users_devkit_profile_check.name: users_devkit_profile_check
users_devkit_profile_check.value: devkit_profile IS NULL OR devkit_profile IN ('agents', 'claude', 'cursor', 'revealui', 'zed')
